headline: 绿灯军团领跑今日热搜 新片静待周末
headlineEn: Green Lantern Corps Tops Today's Trends; New Films Await Weekend
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共三部新片。绿灯军团、奥德赛、玩具总动员5等成为今日最热话题，影市蓄势待发。
summaryEn: No new releases today; three new films this week. Green Lantern Corps, The Odyssey, Toy Story 5 and others dominate today's buzz as the box office gears up.

industryHighlights.text: 今日上映影片数量为零，影市暂无新片入市
industryHighlights.en: Zero films hit theaters today, with no new titles entering the market.

industryHighlights.text: 本周共有三部新片上映，市场等待周末发力
industryHighlights.en: Three new films release this week, with the market awaiting the weekend push.

industryHighlights.text: 绿灯军团连续霸榜今日及本周热搜
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps tops both today's and this week's trending lists.

industryHighlights.text: 多部高话题大片（奥德赛、玩具总动员5等）持续引发关注
industryHighlights.en: Highly anticipated titles like The Odyssey and Toy Story 5 keep generating buzz.
